text:
tim: anyone know the fastest way to get raw request lines from a trace id? console hides the x-request-id for me.

maria: if you have the trace id, open the Console -> Traces and search the trace id. click the top span, then check the right-hand pane for 'Related logs' or span attributes. if header is present you can copy it and search logs.

tim: i did that, 'Related logs' shows nothing. the span has header.X-Request-Id: abc123 but no linked logs in the UI.

sam: ok — two quick paths: Logs UI query (copy header value) or CLI (stern/kubectl or our log-archiver). logs can be indexed under different keys depending on the proxy. try multiple keys.

sam: example queries you can paste into Logs explorer: 
```
# Logs UI (lucene-ish)
headers.x-request-id:"abc123"
# or common indexed fields
request_id:"abc123"
http.headers.x-request-id:"abc123"
```

sam: CLI options: 
```
# stream logs from runtime pods and filter locally (fast)
stern -n prod 'runtime' --since 1h | rg 'abc123' -n -C 3
# single pod historical lines
kubectl logs -n prod pod/runtime-5f6 -c runtime --since=2h | rg abc123
# if request went through edge/ingress
stern -n infra 'ingress' --since 1h | rg 'abc123'
```

lee: also try variations of the header name — indexing sometimes squashes hyphens or lowercases: x-request-id, X-Request-Id, x_request_id, request_id.

tim: why would the Console trace not link to logs even when header exists?

maria: common reasons: trace sampling without full log attachment, time range mismatch (console shows trace but logs are outside the default window), or logs didn't carry the trace_id field when ingested. check trace attributes for trace_id and then search logs for that trace_id too.

jun: if you can grab the span attributes blob, look for both trace_id and request id. sometimes the proxy rewrites the header; searching logs for trace_id:TRACEVAL can succeed where header searches fail.

ops-bot: deploy-bot deployed runtime v2.14 to prod at 2026-03-17T22:12Z :rocket:

tim: last ask — quick command to pull archived raw JSON lines that contain the request id (S3/archives)?

sam: we have the log-archiver tool:
```
log-archiver query --start "2026-03-17T21:00:00Z" --end "2026-03-17T23:00:00Z" --match "abc123" --format jsonl | jq '.'
```

lee: if you want i can run a broad grep across shards (will be noisy). also file a bug with the request id + trace id so we can add a quick alert if this pattern recurs.

tim: thanks — i'll try the variations and the archiver. pinging if i need help :pray:
